title: Innovation Engineer, New Products (f/m/d)
description:
Explore and validate new product ideas for our technology portfolio.

What you'll do
- Evaluate concepts and build prototypes
- Plan experiments and analyse results
- Work with product management and production

What you bring
- A completed degree in engineering, with experience in a lab, a student project or an innovation team that includes designing concepts, building and testing functional models with 3D printing, electronics and scripting, documenting results for decision makers, working with suppliers on small series, and presenting findings to management
- Good English
